card.title: Let Go of the Grudge
card.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender resentment, distance, or a claim that keeps the relationship stuck.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let me help you move. Missing your birthday shouldn't mean I'm banned from every box.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I needed you then. You didn't show.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I know. I'm here now. Give me one thing you can bear to trust me with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The birthday glasses. Still wrapped, since nobody came.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll carry them carefully. Could we unwrap two at your new place?

mechanism: A seeks a small restored place in B's life by accepting responsibility for a painful object and proposing shared use.
confusable: Unlike denying the missed birthday, A must persuade B to relax the exclusion that keeps repair impossible.
comparison: D84-b carries birthday glasses toward a possible shared drink; D84-a replaces an empty-chair punishment with listening.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
